Definition: of Chaldee origin (compare H1660 and H8081); oil-press; Gethsemane, a garden near Jerusalem:--Gethsemane.
BiblicalUsage: Gethsēmanē is the garden where Jesus prayed before His arrest. It stands in Matthew 26:36 and Mark 14:32, where Jesus tells His disciples to sit while He goes to pray.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gethsemane matters because it is where the Saviour’s obedience was tested in prayer. I hold that the garden’s name is worth knowing, because the night there changed everything.
RelatedEvents: The Last Supper; Jesus Prays in Gethsemane
